pr_title: Bluetooth: PACS: Add PAC data to pac_notify
pr_body:
This fixes the pac_notify (formerly pac_indicate) to actually notify the PAC records to the connected clients. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41191
fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41192
pr_comments: Rebased in attempt to trigger new review rules from https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/43303 but to no success

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Update pac_indicate to actually send data
issue_context.body: pac_indicate has not been implemented to send any actual data, where it should send the PAC records.

review_comments: Looks unrelated, thus I'd suggest to push this change it in another commit

It was missing from the callback, but the documentation added is specific for this as `bt_audio_capability_register` triggers the `bt_pacs_add_capability` function which in turn calls the callback with `conn == NULL`. So it is related to the change.
